evidenceBoundary: Structural and deterministic scripted-provider evidence only. No live cloud inference was invoked.

deterministicMeasurements.tiny: Both arms completed with zero children and zero provider calls.
deterministicMeasurements.normalHealthy: The single-agent arm and adaptive arm both completed; adaptive used two child/provider calls.
deterministicMeasurements.normalReviewerRepair: The single-agent arm was blocked by the semantic verifier; the adaptive arm completed after one reviewer-led revision, three child/provider calls, and two coder attempts.
deterministicMeasurements.complexHealthy: The single-agent arm and adaptive arm both completed; adaptive used four child/provider calls.
deterministicMeasurements.measurementNotes: Request bytes are observed from AgentRuntime. Provider token values are scripted usage. Wall time is recorded but not used to declare a crossover.

proven: adaptive normal and complex topology executes through the production Explorer/Planner/Reviewer path
a reviewer can drive one bounded corrective revision before ForgeVerify
the semantic verifier and completion gate still decide terminal success
subagent overhead is visible when correctness is equal
notProven: reconciliation of conflicting live child results
requiredNextEvidence: Paired live free-route topology runs with the same repository state, model budget, verifier, and completion criteria; record only observed provider receipts and preserve quota or availability blockers.
